## Cyberdeck.cortexShare() method

Loans neural bandwidth (and ram) to produce neurodes.

**Signature:**

```typescript
cortexShare(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

RAM cost: 2.4 GB

While active, this will slowly produce neurodes over time. Active for ten seconds. The more threads you loan, the faster the neurodes are produced. Increased thread count has diminishing returns.

The neurode farms are always hungry for fresh cognitive activity. Though, there's a catch: some part of you is always half in the tank.
